title_zh: 兰州市住房和城乡建设局副局长蒲泽元接受审查调查
title_en: Pu Zeyuan, Deputy Director of Lanzhou Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau, Under Investigation
summary_zh: 兰州市住房和城乡建设局党组成员、副局长蒲泽元涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受兰州市纪委监委纪律审查和监察调查。
summary_en: Pu Zeyuan, Deputy Director of the Lanzhou Housing and Urban-Rural Development Bureau, is under investigation by the Lanzhou Municipal Commission for Discipline Inspection and Supervisory Commission for suspected serious violations of discipline and law.
